Company Description
 Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.
ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.
 Job Description
 The Senior Business Intelligence Consultant designs and scales Power BI-based reporting and analytics solutions to enable data-driven decision-making across the global purchasing organization. In this role, you will work closely with IT, procurement, and other internal stakeholders to establish data rules, maintain data integrity, and foster a data-driven culture within the organization.
We are looking for a BI expert who connects business processes with analytics platforms. You will act as a key driver of the Purchasing BI landscape, enabling self-service reporting, standardizing KPIs, and delivering scalable dashboards across the organization.
In this role, you will help shape the future of the SMART Purchasing landscape and contribute to building a data-driven global purchasing organization. If you are passionate about interfaces between business processes and data technologies, you might be just the right fit.
BI Development & Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for global purchasing stakeholders
Data Modeling & Architecture: Develop scalable data models and ensure optimal performance of BI solutions
BI Consultancy: Advise stakeholders on best practices in reporting, KPI design, and self-service analytics
Platform Optimization: Continuously improve Power BI environment, data pipelines, and reporting performance
Data Visualization & Storytelling: Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready dashboards; both for executive and end users
Project Management and Stakeholder Collaboration: Manage data integration projects and partner with IT, finance, and operations as the primary stakeholder interface; ensuring alignment and delivery of data initiatives
Compliance: Ensure adherence to company policies, regulations, and legal requirements
Training & Support: Enable users through training and support in Power BI and self-service analytics
 Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in data science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
Experience: 3–5+ years in Business Intelligence or reporting, with proven expertise in data management
Technical Skills: Expert-level experience in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, performance optimization)
Core Skills: Strong experience with Power BI (mandatory), SQL/querying, data modeling, and ETL/data integration concepts
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across stakeholders
Ability to work independently while being a team player
Advanced analytical skills to interpret complex data, identify process–data relationships, and drive value-enhancing purchasing solutions
 Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of industry-specific data management practices and standards
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks) is a plus
Purchasing experience is an advantage, but not required
 Additional Information
 What we offer:
The 13-th salary – Paid once a year, in December;
Meal tickets - With a value of 40 Ron;
Private Health Insurance – Health is the most important, so we offer you a medical subscription through Signal Iduna;
Referral bonuses - We encourage colleagues to refer new candidates to us and, at the same time, to get the chance to receive a bonus;
Bookster – Feed your body and your mind. You can borrow books and you’ll receive them at the office;
Sports benefits- It’s important to stay active, so we offer you the 7Card;
Discounts at our partners – We collaborate with different vendors, and we receive discounts for various products/ services like rubbers, restaurants, kindergartens, etc;
System for Rewarding Improvement Ideas – We have an internal improvement program (Continental Idea Management) that gives you the opportunity to come up with ideas and to be honored with an attractive bonus (this is established by the CIM team according to your improvement idea);
Happy days – If you or your child is getting married, or you become a parent, you receive some extra free days;
Life events celebration - If your family is growing, we praise your newborn with a bonus;
Unfortunate events - In case of unhappy events in your life, we support you by offering you free days and financial support (handled on a case by-case basis);
Extra vacation days – You begin with 22 vacation days/year, and starting with the 3rd year with us, we offer you 1 more day of vacation and. We reward employees who reach 15 and 20 years within the company with another day of vacation, reaching a maximum of 29 days.
Professional development - Many opportunities to develop yourself within the company;
Diversity and multicultural mindset - We encourage you to join us no matter who, where, or what you are. We have colleagues from different nations and a variety of languages are spoken in our company.
